Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 105. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You have mastered techniques to take advantage of
every drop in any enemy’s guard, gaining the following
benefits.
When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack,
the creature’s speed becomes 0 for the rest of the
turn.
Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even
if they take the Disengage action before leaving your
reach.
When a creature makes an attack against a target
other than you (and that target doesn’t have this
feat), you can use your reaction to make a melee
weapon attack against the attacking creature.
